newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

In answer to a question, spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said that as of 1000 GMT the Commission had not received any reaction to the letter it sent last week to Spanish telecoms company Telefonica. Following two complaints from CanalSatelite the Commission had given Telefonica until August 18 to respond to one of them. Vale de Almeida said he hoped to be able to provide more information on Tuesday.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/758: The Commission takes part in the 12th World Youth Day in Paris.
